'''Yotts Oren''' was a [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] who served in the [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] of the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. In [[4 ABY]], they flew aboard a [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] in order to watch the [[Death|execution]] of three of Jabba's [[prisoner]]s: the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]].

Upon reaching their destination, the [[skiff]] carrying the prisoners stopped over the pit, where they were to be fed to a [[sarlacc]]. Skywalker was selected to be pushed in first, but [[Rescue of Han Solo|attacked]] the guards after being armed with his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]]. After all of the guards on the prisoners' skiff had been defeated, the skiff carrying Oren approached so that the guards on board could try and take down Skywalker. Instead, the Jedi boarded their skiff and defeated Oren and their colleagues, knocking the Kadas'sa'Nikto into the [[Mouth|maw]] of the sarlacc.

==Biography==
The [[Kadas'sa'Nikto]] Yotts Oren<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> worked as a guard for the [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] and served as part of his [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]] in [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]].<ref name="ROTJ" /> In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> Jabba ordered that three of his [[prisoner]]s—the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] and the [[smuggler]]s [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]—be transported by [[skiff]] to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon]] and fed to the [[sarlacc]] that dwelt there. Oren was part of a group of guards that flew on a second [[Bantha-II cargo skiff]] piloted by the [[Skrilling]] [[Pote Snitkin]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and traveled alongside the vehicle that carried the prisoners. Once the vehicles reached the pit, the skiff carrying the prisoners flew out over the sarlacc,<ref name="ROTJ" /> while the skiff carrying Oren began joyriding around in circles over the [[desert]].<ref name="Beware">''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]''</ref>

[[File:YottsOrenDeath.png|thumb|left|250px|Yotts Oren fell to their death in the sarlacc pit.]]
Jabba, who had traveled to the pit aboard his [[sail barge]],<ref name="ROTJ" /> ''[[Khetanna]]'',<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> to view the [[Death|executions]], gave the prisoners one last chance to beg for their lives. When they refused, Jabba ordered that the first prisoner, Skywalker, be pushed in to the waiting [[Mouth|maw]] of the sarlacc. However, Skywalker managed to leap back onto the skiff and, armed with a [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber|lightsaber]] provided by his [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], [[Rescue of Han Solo|attacked]] the guards aboard the prisoners' skiff. As Skywalker dispatched the last of the guards aboard his own skiff, Snitkin piloted his skiff closer so that Oren and the others on board could fire at Skywalker. The [[Nikto]] leaned out over the railing of the skiff and fired at Skywalker with a [[blaster pistol]], after which the Jedi boarded the second skiff and began to fight the guards that were on board.<ref name="ROTJ" />

Once Skywalker was aboard the skiff, Oren initially dropped back toward Snitkin at the rear of the vehicle. After Skywalker knocked<ref name="ROTJ" /> [[Brock Starsher]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and another guard overboard, the Nikto rushed forward past their other comrades to attack. The Jedi then slashed at Oren's face, causing them to tumble backward over the skiff's railing and directly into the maw of the sarlacc. Skywalker and his allies subsequently defeated the remainder of the guards and killed Jabba before destroying the sail barge and escaping.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Personality and traits==
Oren had [[Color|green]] skin and black [[eye]]s.<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Equipment==
While on the skiff, Oren wore a black [[Clothing|hood]] and [[pauldron]] with two black [[bandolier]]s crossed over a gray [[shirt]] and gray pants. They also wore black [[Clothing|shoes]], gray wristbands, and used a [[DL-18 blaster pistol]].<ref name="ROTJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:YottsOren.png|thumb|right|250px|Yotts Oren appeared in ''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi''.]]
Yotts Oren first appeared in the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="ROTJ" /> The character's full head mask measured thirty-six centimeters by fifty-three centimeters by thirty-three centimeters.<ref name="Archives">''[[From Star Wars to Indiana Jones: The Best of the Lucasfilm Archives]]''</ref> The scream used for Oren's fall into the sarlacc pit is the [[Wilhelm scream]], which is used for multiple other characters throughout ''Return of the Jedi'' and the other ''[[Star Wars]]'' films.<ref name="ROTJ" /><ref name="RadioTimes">{{WebCite|url=https://www.radiotimes.com/movies/a-long-running-star-wars-tradition-has-been-put-to-rest|text=A long-running Star Wars tradition has been put to rest|author=Ling, Thomas|date=2018-02-22|archivedate=20180602044947}}</ref> The scenes on Oren's skiff were filmed in the [[Yuma]] desert in [[Wikipedia:Arizona|Arizona]] between [[April 12]] and [[April 24]], [[1982]], with the skiffs then moved to [[Industrial Light & Magic]] in [[Wikipedia:California|California]] for blue screen shots that were filmed between [[May 10]] and [[May 14|14]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Return of the Jedi]]''</ref>

In the new ''Star Wars'' [[canon]], Oren was first identified in "[[The Battle of Hoth and the Second Death Star]]," an issue of the [[Star Wars Encyclopedia (series)|''Star Wars Encyclopedia'']] series published by [[De Agostini]]<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> on [[December 11]], [[2020]].<ref name="Altaya">{{Altaya|url=livres-bd/encyclopedie-star-wars|text=Official Star Wars Encyclopedia|date=2020-07-10}}</ref> The character's name originated as "[[Yotts Orren]]" in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity on a card in the [[2001]] ''[[Tatooine Limited]]'' set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]]; however, the card incorrectly pictured<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Tatooine Limited|cardname=Yotts Orren}}</ref> the Kadas'sa'Nikto [[Klaatu/Legends|Klaatu]].<ref name="Insider134">{{InsiderCite|134|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: An Audience with Jabba the Hutt}}</ref> The hooded Nikto was then identified as Yotts Orren in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" feature of [[Star Wars Insider 143|''Star Wars Insider'' 143]]<ref name="Insider">{{InsiderCite|143|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Jabba's Henchmen!}}</ref> on [[July 23]], [[2013]].<ref name="InsiderDate">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/143|text=''Star Wars Insider'' 143}}</ref> Despite this, a card added to the [[Star Wars: Card Trader|''Star Wars'': Card Trader]] app in [[2017]] as part of the "Galactic Underworld: Live-Action" series misidentified an image of Yotts Oren as [[Klaatu]].<ref name="galacticunderworld_klaatu">{{SWCT|set=Galactic Underworld|cardname=Klaatu}}</ref>
